Lina Morales: Heads-up — we're handing the new eu-west3 GPU cluster (rw-gpu-eu-w3) over to on-call tomorrow 09:00 UTC. 
Checklist I'm sharing below — paging configs, ownership, escalation paths, and a short training runthrough. Please read and call out any gaps. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/rw-gpu-eu-w3-runbook :memo:

Lina Morales: Runbook highlights:
- PagerDuty service: rw-eu-w3-gpu (service id: PD12345)
- Slack pre-alert -> PagerDuty after 3m unresolved
- Primary on-call: Mike (first 48h), rotation then as scheduled
- Ops playbooks: node drain, GPU driver rollback, oom-scan
- Validation steps: k8s healthcheck, smoke inference, perf spike test, cost tagging

Lina Morales: PagerDuty snippet (for ops team to verify):
```
service: rw-eu-w3-gpu
routing_key: pdtok_live_abc123
escalation_policy: EP_gpu_ops
conditions:
  - metric: gpu_utilization
    threshold: 92
    duration: 120s
  - metric: node_memory_rss_percent
    threshold: 88
    duration: 60s
```

Mike (SRE): acked. Quick Q — what are the exact rules for thermal/GPU-temp alerts? we've had noisy pages on <90C before. Also want the OOM killer alert thresholds.

Lina Morales: Good point. Thermal rule: GPU core temp > 95C for 90s => page. Warn at 90C with slack-only. OOM: any kernel OOM event on node => immediate page. We'll include dmesg matchers in the alert.

Sam K: Can we add a slack-only soft-alert channel (#rw-eu-w3-alerts) that gets first look for 2m before escalating? Ops can ack there to suppress PD. :thumbsup:

Lina Morales: Yes — proposed flow: slack soft-alert -> if no ack in 2m escalate to PD -> if PD acked but unresolved after 15m auto-create incident note and trigger rollback policy. I'll update runbook.

Priya: Who's the primary for on-call training & shadowing during the handoff window? I want to make sure new folks know the node-replace flow.

Taylor EngOnCall: Schedule is posted in Ops calendar. Primary for first 48h = Mike. Backup shift rotation as listed (Taylor -> Priya -> Sam). I'll DM the sheet to the new joiners.

deploy-bot: Provisioning complete — cluster rw-gpu-eu-w3 created. Nodes: 12 gpus, k8s v1.26. Labels: gpu-type=rtx6000, region=eu-west3. Logs: https://ci.redwood/prov/7890

Mike (SRE): Need a short training slot to review: - `kubectl drain` with GPU eviction flags - kernel driver rollback steps - how to attach ephemeral debug nodes. Can we schedule 30m walkthru at 08:00 UTC?

Lina Morales: Yep — 30m runthrough planned at 08:00 UTC tomorrow (30m, remote). I'll drop meeting link and a quick cheat-sheet here. Cheat-sheet snippet:
```
# drain node for replacement
kubectl drain NODE_NAME --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
# label GPU node for maintenance
kubectl label node NODE_NAME maintenance=scheduled --overwrite
```
Docs: https://redwood-internal/docs/rw-gpu-eu-w3-runbook#maintenance

Priya: Validation checklist (short):
1) k8s node status all Ready
2) smoke: run 3 short inferences (50 tokens) across 3 models
3) perf: 5m p95 latency under 400ms
4) cost tags: owner=ml-team, cost-center=eng-ml-eu
5) enable budget alert: daily burn > $600 -> slack warn

Sam K: Also recommend enabling a soft budget alert and a tagging policy — set Cloud Billing alert: threshold 75% of forecast month-to-date. Link: https://cloud.redwood/billing/alerts

Lina Morales: Thanks all. I'll update the PD/Slack routing in the runbook, add the training meeting, and post the final handoff note at 08:30 UTC tomorrow after the live runthrough. Please react with :thumbsup: if this looks good or drop concerns now.

Mike (SRE): :thumbsup:
Sam K: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
